status_summary: The Open America's Waters Act, introduced in the Senate as S. 2043 and in the House as H.R. 3940 on 2025-06-12, would repeal the Jones Act restrictions on coastwise trade by rewriting the coastwise endorsement statute and repealing related provisions. No committee or floor action was found. Separately, a temporary waiver of the law for energy and related products, announced in March 2026, was extended for 90 days from 2026-08-17 through 2026-11-15; a waiver is an existing executive tool and does not change the statute.
